fields.statement: QA by hand with this branch's build (0c176623) in a scratch repo: rhiza workflow check passes .rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml with autonomous = true and partial.toml with [autonomy] plan = "auto"; it exits 1 naming the key for autonomous plus [autonomy] together ('autonomous and [autonomy] are both set'), [autonomy] deploy ('autonomy.deploy: unknown stage; want plan, accept, ship, signoff'), plan = "yes" ('autonomy.plan: yes is not a mode') and autonomous = "yes" ('autonomous: yes is not a boolean'). go test ./internal/workflow passes.

QA by hand with this branch's build (0c176623) in a scratch repo: with no repo workflow rhiza health's autonomy part lists only 'workflow plan-milestone (builtin:plan-milestone): plan owner, accept owner, ship owner, signoff owner'; with .rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml declaring autonomous = true it adds 'workflow bugfix (.rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml): plan auto, accept auto, ship auto, signoff auto', and a partial [autonomy] file shows only its declared stage; rhiza health --json and rhiza api call health printed identical bytes (cmp).

QA with this branch's build (0c176623): run start is refused inside an agent session, so origin/main's run-start-milestone-autonomous.txtar (deleted on this branch) was run against the branch: rhiza run start --foreground --workflow plan --new 'Plan the milestone' --milestone --permission-mode manual --autonomous is not refused; it runs workflow plan-milestone with 'Autonomous: yes' while run status shows every stage 'owner from workflow plan-milestone'. The amended acceptance (usage error naming plan-milestone's declaration, no journal, no draft; run resume refusal) is not met, and no script on the branch checks it.
